title: The dependency array: none, [] or [a, b]

slides.say: The second argument of use effect changes everything. There are three ways to write it.

slides.text: No array: runs after every render.
slides.say: With no dependency array, the effect runs after every single render.

slides.text: Empty array: runs only when the component appears.
slides.say: With an empty array, it runs only on mount, when the component appears.

slides.text: [a, b]: on mount, then again if a or b changed.
slides.say: With a and b in the array, it runs on mount, and again only if a or b changed since the last render.

slides.text: React skips the Effect only if ALL dependencies are the same as last render.
slides.say: React skips re-running the effect only when every dependency has exactly the same value as during the previous render.

slides.text: None = always. [] = once. [a, b] = on change.
slides.say: No array means always. Empty array means once. A list means whenever something in it changes.
